correctness.rationale: RESULT.md lines 29–44: each cyclic mask has one 1100 cluster and otherwise alternates. When periods tend to infinity, bounded windows converge either to alternation or to a translate of one isolated cluster. This also proves the list of mask orbits and least periods, and a countable invariant mask space supports ergodic probabilities only on finite orbits. Finite periods 2k with k≤n contribute at most n(n+1) words; long-period and limit words give at most n+3 cluster placements and two alternating words. The prefix discrepancy ranges from −1 to 1, so every mask word has at most floor(n/2)+1 ones; alternating windows suffice for the lower bound. Counting pairs (mask word, descendant) gives the same entropy bound for the compact extension. Over a period-2k phase the return map is a full shift on 2^k symbols with the unique uniform product maximizer. Phase conditioning loses at most log(2k) per whole word; each projected maximizer therefore retains entropy. An ergodic maximizing measure on X has an ergodic invariant lift by invariant lifting and extremality; its mask marginal is a finite orbit and the same entropy upper bound forces the product maximizer there. Frequencies on residue classes recover the phase; mixing of the return map excludes any additional cyclic factor. A finite graph edge-shift cover would have finitely many ergodic maximizers at the factor entropy (the standard finite-to-one right-resolving presentation), contradicting the list. Wu–Zhang Theorem A and equations (1),(4),(6),(7) were checked against the cited arXiv text: the strict-gap premise is excluded, and the minimal-forbidden prefix bound and generation by minimal forbidden words give h_G≤h_M≤h_top. No journal status or formal verification is inferred. The supplied verify_masks.py was read, not run; it tests finite layers, not equality or the infinite classification.
